name: Cognizant Prompt Library Marketplace
description: Comprehensive AI prompt library for SDLC automation, code generation, cloud infrastructure, tech migration, testing, security, and more. Works with Amazon Q Developer and Claude Code Companion.
author: Cognizant

plugins.name: SDLC & Development Workflow
plugins.description: Full SDLC automation: user story creation, requirement documents, design diagrams, pseudocode, test plans, deployment scripts, and JIRA-integrated workflow automation.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: REST API Creation
plugins.description: Comprehensive REST API development: microservice generation, Spring Boot REST, .NET WebAPI, Swagger-to-code, SOAP/WSDL, and API gateway patterns.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Spring Boot Code Generation
plugins.description: Spring Boot application scaffolding: entity/service/repository/controller, JPA mappings, async tasks, POM management, log4j and Spring context configuration.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: React UI Development
plugins.description: Complete React application: components, hooks, Redux, React Query, lifecycle methods, DOM, HTTP requests, event handling, CSS, forms, routing, and build generation.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Angular UI Development
plugins.description: Full Angular application: components, modules, routing, forms, services, directives, Material UI, authentication, pagination, HTTP requests, and Angular CLI.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Technology Migration
plugins.description: Step-by-step migration: Struts to Spring Boot/MVC, EJB to Spring, AngularJS to Angular/React, .NET Framework to .NET Core, Flex to Vue.js, VB6 to .NET MVC/WinForms, and cross-language rewrites.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Technology Version Upgrade
plugins.description: In-place upgrades: Java 8 to 17, Spring Boot 1x to 2x, Spring Core 3x/4x to 5x, Hibernate 4x to 5x — dependency updates, deprecated API fixes, and build verification.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Testing & QA
plugins.description: End-to-end testing: unit/integration test generation, BDD feature files, step definitions, QA artifacts (test plan, defect template, RTM), Serenity reports, and framework migration.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: AWS Cloud Services
plugins.description: AWS infrastructure code: S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, SES, Kinesis, Redshift, Rekognition, SageMaker, EBS, API Gateway, VPC, CloudFormation, EKS, and SDK module templates.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Azure Cloud Services
plugins.description: Azure infrastructure code: Blob Storage, Functions, SQL Database, API Management, Virtual Network, Event Grid, Logic Apps, Cosmos DB, Kubernetes Service, and Terraform modules.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Google Cloud Platform
plugins.description: GCP infrastructure code: Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Deployment Manager, GKE, and Terraform module templates.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: CI/CD & DevOps
plugins.description: Pipeline automation: GitHub Actions and Jenkins for build, test, deploy, Docker image push, code quality, security scanning, artifact packaging, and Kubernetes YAML generation.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Security & Vulnerability Management
plugins.description: Security code and analysis: authentication (JWT, OAuth, SSO, MFA), encryption, Checkmarx/SonarQube vulnerability fixes, OWASP remediation, and Node.js cryptography (AES, RSA).
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Database & SQL
plugins.description: Database operations and SQL: DDL (create/drop tables, views, indexes), DML (CRUD), stored procedures, triggers, cursors, transactions, JDBC, JPA queries, joins, and aggregations.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Code Quality & Documentation
plugins.description: Code review and docs: add comments, explain code, fix issues, optimize performance, generate Mermaid diagrams (class, sequence, flowchart, ER, mindmap), and produce functional documentation.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Design Patterns & Algorithms
plugins.description: Design pattern implementations (Factory, Builder, Abstract, Delegate) and algorithm generation (binary/linear search, FCFS, sorting) for Java and other languages.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Third-Party Library Integration
plugins.description: Integration templates: Apache Commons IO, Guava, Jackson, JUnit, Hibernate, JGit/Git SDK, Sendgrid email, and Node.js Winston logger.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: .NET Web Development
plugins.description: .NET Core web applications: MVC, REST APIs, Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, SignalR real-time apps, and WebSockets.
plugins.author: Cognizant

plugins.name: Demo Utilities
plugins.description: Tiny demo plugin with 4 sample skills and 1 sample agent. Use it to smoke-test the marketplace install flow end-to-end without touching the production prompt library.
plugins.author: Marketplace Test
